reasons: Prerequisites for CS4234 (MA1513 or YSC2232) are not completed and cannot be taken due to the 1 module/semester limit and lack of available slots for prerequisites.
Prerequisites for CS3236 (EE2012 or MA2216 etc.) are not completed and cannot be taken due to the 1 module/semester limit.

Prerequisites for CS4225 (CS2102) are not completed; CS2102 requires CS2030S (completed) and CS1231/MA1100 (CS1231S completed, but CS2102 also requires CS2040S or similar which is completed, however CS2102 prerequisite is (CS1231 or ... ) AND (CS2030S or ...). CS1231S satisfies the first part. CS2030S satisfies the second. So CS2102 is eligible. But CS4225 needs CS2102. CS3236 needs EE2012/MA2216 etc which are missing.
